body: Standing interim rule (Greg via Engram::Asistant #1915, relayed by Fable2 in TermAl mailbox 4daa5b87 #6558, 2026-11-16 16:59Z). Nothing a delegation creates may go under ~/.termal/delegations. Until w-eb21094eba5a lands, any isolated-worktree worker delegation that Opus2 or anyone it coordinates spawns passes an explicit worktree path inside the source repository's .tmp/; the default (no path) lands in ~/.termal/delegations and is NOT allowed. Read-only reviewer delegations create no worktree and are unaffected. Existing folders under ~/.termal/delegations: touch nothing; cleanup only by a Greg-approved procedure that Fable2 sends. Opus3 owns the fix (w-eb21094eba5a and w-26abac74c80a, the test leak into the real ~/.termal) and takes lanes as they free, without jumping the 443e, 5c8b or 54e3 gates. Include this condition in every GO that permits a worker delegation.
